ground_truth_reconciliation.discrepancy_explanation: In initial evaluation, an internal sort_values call altered row ordering relative to the original DataFrame, causing sliced type masks to misalign with label arrays. Strict row-order preservation is now enforced and verified via automated assertion.

gnn_graphsage_cached_snapshot.scope_clarification: Measures partial-path online scoring (real candidate edge attribute construction + precomputed snapshot embedding lookup + Edge MLP head). It is NOT complete end-to-end latency because embedding generation is performed asynchronously out-of-band.

gnn_graphsage_uncached_on_demand.scope_clarification: Measures synchronous full-graph message passing on CPU across active topology (763k nodes, 415k edges). Exceeds strict real-time authorization SLAs (<50 ms). In production, online 2-hop neighborhood sampling could evaluate a smaller subgraph (5-50 nodes), but dynamic neighborhood sampling is not implemented in Sentinel.

temporal_protocol_disclosure.causal_training_protocol: 20 causal chronological windows of 25 hours each (steps 1-500). Message passing occurs strictly over settled edges prior to each window; node features reflect prior historical counters. Designed for memory efficiency and stable gradient optimization.
temporal_protocol_disclosure.streaming_evaluation_protocol: 123 hourly streaming steps (steps 621-743). Seeded with settled history through step 620. For each step s, candidates are evaluated against historical graph state prior to step s, and settled only after prediction.
temporal_protocol_disclosure.protocol_distinction: Training windows are batched over 25 hours to prevent GPU/CPU memory overflow and enable batch gradient descent, whereas evaluation simulates true real-time transaction arrival step-by-step. They are not identical protocols, but both strictly enforce the causality invariant (t_pred > t_graph).

topology_finding.illustration_clarification: The 2-hop money mule path (Victim -> Mule -> Cash-out) presented in Figure 14 is a CONCEPTUAL ARCHITECTURAL ILLUSTRATION of mobile-money fraud mechanics. In PaySim synthetic data, transactions are generated as disjoint pairs, meaning accounts do not participate in multi-hop chains within the simulation. Ring detection is not claimed on PaySim.
topology_finding.synthetic_limitation: PaySim generates random account strings per transaction, preventing dense cycle formation. The GNN's value lies in inductive structural node embeddings and neighbor degree aggregation.
